svg.title: Why we built this
svg.desc: The motivation: a database sensor sat in Pending for 8 hours because the connector did a blocking snapshot of a large table before it saw a single live change. A conversation with a Debezium maintainer turned that into a question about what CDC should be on Kubernetes.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: We pointed a database sensor at a real table and it sat in Pending.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Not for seconds — for 8 hours. The connector was doing a blocking

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: snapshot of the whole table before it reported a single live change.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: That blind window is what started this.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: If an operator can watch a database for us, it should start seeing

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: changes immediately — and tell us when it cannot.

text.font-family: Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
Inter, Geist, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
